name: dnaa-3-box-binding
title: Study 3 — Evaluate Chromosomal Binding

seeded_from.reason:
Builds directly on the dnaa-2 V=1e-3 succinate baseline (bf8b82e integrate_dt
mechanism + DnaA-ATP intrinsic hydrolysis). dnaa-3 adds DnaA-box occupancy on
top of that DnaA-ATP/ADP/apo pool without changing initiation.

question:
With DnaA binding to its 315 boxes (4 affinity pools: 302 chromosomal-high,
3 oriC-high, 8 oriC-low, 2 promoter-high) in fast equilibrium on top of the
dnaa-2 V=1e-3 succinate baseline, does the cell cycle stay unchanged (8/8
divisions, oriC 1↔2, 0 re-init) and the DnaA-ATP fraction stay in the
[0.2,0.5] band — i.e. does adding the read-only binding observer leave the
validated dnaa-2 behaviour intact while exposing the bound/free +
per-nucleotide partitioning that later regulatory studies need?

report.title: dnaa-3 — DnaA box binding (chromosomal + oriC + dnaA-promoter)
report.objective:
On top of the validated dnaa-2 succinate baseline, distribute the DnaA-ATP /
DnaA-ADP pool across the 315 DnaA boxes (chromosomal + oriC + dnaA-promoter)
by affinity, in fast equilibrium, WITHOUT disturbing the dnaa-2 cell cycle —
exposing the bound/free + per-nucleotide partitioning that later
regulatory studies will build on.
report.main_insight:
DESIGN (not yet run). Four affinity pools over 315 boxes: chromosomal_high
(302 consensus TTWTNCACA boxes), oriC_high (3 — R1/R2/R4), oriC_low (8
non-consensus, supplied explicitly), promoter_high (2). Binding is modelled as
FAST equilibrium (P = C/(C+K_d)) on the timestep, read off the free DnaA-ATP /
DnaA-ADP concentration. The bet: a pure read-only binding observer, with no new
regulation and no mutation of the DnaA pool, leaves the dnaa-2 behaviour intact
(8/8 divisions, oriC 1↔2, 0 re-init, DnaA-ATP fraction in band) while making
bound/free occupancy observable for downstream studies. Six-step build plan
(partition catalog → low-aff coords → binding equilibria → bound-pool
species/state → listener+viz → validate). Only the provided binding mechanism
is modelled here.
report.result:
>> CURRENT RESULT (2026-06-10, V tuned per Rashmi's 15:31 feedback): Rashmi's ACTIVE
box-binding mechanism is ADOPTED (PR #162). After she flagged the DnaA pool
overshooting at V=1e-3, TUNED the dnaA expression DOWN to V=0.8e-3 (dnaa-1's in-band
value). Canonical run dnaa3_adopt_v0p8e3_seed0 (8 gens, 8/8 divided). Findings:
(a) OVER-BINDING RESOLVED + GRADUAL FILLING — oriC-low occupancy fills gradually over
the cycle (gen-5 ~0.30 at birth -> ~0.62 toward initiation; chart dnaa3_box_occupancy),
NOT pre-filled, NOT pinned ~0.8.
(b) ALL boxes double 315<->630 (low-aff 8->16 included) — chart
dnaa3_active_binding_adopted panel 2.
(c) DnaA pool IN-BAND (the overshoot fix) — the spine evaluator (gen_steady_state
per-gen averages) computes total DnaA (bulk+bound) at 365/348/382/393/... across gens,
ALL comfortably within [300,800] (code PASS); steady-gen mean 630 (down from 837 at
V=1e-3). Transient pre-division peaks ~1035 (down from 1450) — the inherent
accumulate-then-halve, not a band violation.
(d) HONEST TRADEOFF — tuning V down WORSENS the free DnaA-ATP fraction: 0.127 at
V=0.8e-3 (was 0.186 at 1e-3), further below the dnaa-2 [0.2,0.5] band. This is the
V-TENSION (pool wants ~0.8e-3, ATP fraction wants ~1e-3); no constitutive V satisfies
both — autoregulation (dnaa-4) resolves it. Outcomes here are EVALUATOR-COMPUTED via the
run/outcome spine (compute-outcomes -> RunReader -> computed_outcomes + reconcile), not
hand-keyed. FULL figure set restored on this run: dnaa3_binding_analysis +
dnaa3_fullhist_pergen + box_occupancy/active_binding/readouts. Charts: time in MINUTES,
division lines, no gridlines. The account below is READ-ONLY-ERA history. <<

DECONTAMINATED 2026-06-08 (per Rashmi): the only mechanisms and references in
this study are the provided ones. The DnaA-box model here is the PROVIDED
read-only occupancy observer — 4 affinity pools, fast equilibrium, full box
set, no box-capacity limit and no mutation of the DnaA pool (both of which an
earlier pass had added with outside justification; both removed).
STATUS (read-only era — superseded by the adopted active mechanism above):
• DELIVERED — the DnaA-box OCCUPANCY view (chart dnaa3_occupancy_haochen):
  oriC-low/high occupancy + free DnaA-ATP (nM) over steady gens. It reads the
  real in-sim emitted occupancy from the read-only multi-gen run
  (dnaa3-insim-readonly).
• RAN — dnaa-3 read-only binding observer on the dnaa-2 V=1e-3 succinate seed-1
  lineage. Because the binding is READ-ONLY (it writes only
  listeners.dnaA_binding and never mutates the DnaA pool or the box flags), the
  cell cycle matches the dnaa-2 baseline. All four acceptance tests PASS: 8/8
  divisions, oriC 1↔2 every gen, zero re-initiation, DnaA-ATP fraction in
  [0.2,0.5]. All readouts were plotted from the read-only run (charts retired; superseded): total
  DnaA conc (count/cell MASS), DnaA-ATP fraction, oriC, DnaA bound by pool &
  nucleotide, DnaA boxes free-vs-bound (box count doubles 307→614 with
  replication), cell mass.
• IN-SIM listener — the DnaaBoxBinding deriver fires inside the composite on the
  dnaa-3 ParCa+cache (cache_dnaa3, --mode full) and emits real per-tick
  occupancy to listeners.dnaA_binding. The listener is strictly read-only, so
  the cycle is identical to dnaa-2. Real in-sim numbers from the read-only run
  are recorded under runs[].real_insim_numbers below (free DnaA-ATP, DnaA-ATP
  fraction, oriC low/high occupancy), taken directly from the emitted parquet.
• V-DOWN SWEEP (2026-06-09, seed 1; chart dnaa3_v_sweep_overbinding) — tested
  whether lowering DnaA synthesis V relieves the oriC low-affinity over-binding
  (free DnaA-ATP ≫ the ~100 nM low-aff K_d → ~0.8 occupancy at V=1e-3). Three V:
    V=1.0e-3: free DnaA-ATP ramps 213→452 nM, oriC-low occ 0.68→0.82; total DnaA
              ~535 (in [300,800]); cycle stable 6 gens.
    V=0.8e-3: free DnaA-ATP ~190 nM, oriC-low occ ~0.65; total DnaA ramps to the
              LOW band edge (~200-377); lineage crashes gen 5 (allocator
              NegativeCountsError PROTON[c] — a stochastic timing edge).
    V=0.6e-3: free DnaA-ATP ~145 nM (osc. 79-194), oriC-low occ ~0.57; total DnaA
              220-281 (BELOW the [300,800] band); ATP-frac erratic (0.10-0.51);
              cycle stable 6 gens.
  FINDING: V-tuning is a real but INSUFFICIENT lever. Lowering V monotonically
  cuts free DnaA-ATP and oriC-low occupancy (0.82 → 0.65 → 0.57), exactly per the
  K_d≈100 nM relation. BUT it cannot reach a "modestly occupied" (~0.2-0.3) regime:
  with K_d≈100 nM and the DnaA pool constrained to [300,800] (free DnaA-ATP then
  sits ~100-500 nM), low-aff occupancy is STRUCTURALLY pinned at ~0.5-0.8. Pushing
  V low enough to matter (0.6e-3) drops total DnaA below the literature band and
  destabilizes the DnaA-ATP fraction. So V cannot resolve the over-binding without
  breaking dnaa-1's in-band pool / dnaa-2's fraction band — a different lever
  (low-aff cooperativity, a DnaA sink, or datA titration) is required. This
  corroborates the existing honest over-binding observation; recorded for
  Rashmi/Haochen.
report.review_asks:
For Rashmi / Haochen, before we build:
1. POOL PARTITION — are the four affinity pools right (302 chromosomal-high /
   3 oriC-high R1,R2,R4 / 8 oriC-low / 2 promoter-high), and the per-pool K_d
   values to use?
2. LOW-AFFINITY oriC BOXES — the 8 are non-consensus and supplied explicitly;
   please confirm the coordinates/sequences (step 2 of the build plan).
3. MODELLING CHOICE — is treating box binding as FAST equilibrium
   (integrate_dt=false) the right call here, or should any pool be kinetic?
4. ACCEPTANCE BAR — is "dnaa-2 cell cycle unchanged + DnaA-ATP fraction in band"
   the correct success criterion for a binding-only study (regulation deferred)?

objective:
Add a dynamic DnaA-box occupancy mechanism: distribute the DnaA-ATP / DnaA-ADP
pool (from dnaa-2) across the 315 chromosomal + oriC + dnaA-promoter DnaA boxes
according to affinity, in fast equilibrium, while preserving the dnaa-2 cell
cycle (8/8 divisions, oriC 1↔2, no re-init, DnaA-ATP fraction in band).

purpose.question:
With DnaA binding to its 315 boxes (4 affinity pools) in fast equilibrium on
top of the dnaa-2 baseline, does the cell cycle stay unchanged (8/8 divisions,
oriC 1↔2, 0 re-init) and the DnaA-ATP fraction stay in the [0.2,0.5]
band — i.e. does adding the read-only binding observer leave the validated
dnaa-2 behaviour intact while providing the bound/free partitioning later
studies need?
purpose.mechanism:
DnaA binds 315 boxes in four pools, each a fast equilibrium governed only by
K_d (absolute k_fwd/k_rev are degenerate after the steady-state solve):
  - chromosomal high-affinity (302 sites): K_d ≈ 1 nM, binds DnaA-ATP OR DnaA-ADP
  - oriC high-affinity (3 sites: R1, R2, R4): K_d ≈ 1 nM, binds DnaA-ATP OR DnaA-ADP
  - oriC low-affinity (8 sites): K_d ≈ 100 nM, DnaA-ATP ONLY
  - dnaA-promoter high-affinity (2 sites: box 1, box 2): K_d ≈ 1 nM, ATP OR ADP
High-affinity pools track bound-ATP and bound-ADP SEPARATELY (3 counts: free /
bound-ATP / bound-ADP) so the correct nucleotide form can be released in later
studies. The low-affinity pool tracks 2 counts (free / bound-ATP). DNA binding
does NOT alter the DnaA-ATP intrinsic hydrolysis rate (bf8b82e k≈0.046/min
applies uniformly to bound and free DnaA-ATP).
purpose.expected_outcome:
The dnaa-2 cell cycle is preserved (8/8 divisions, oriC 1↔2, 0 re-init) and the
DnaA-ATP fraction stays in [0.2,0.5]. The chromosomal high-affinity pool (302
sites) is the dominant binding pool. Box count doubles across replication (315
at birth → 630 at termination → 315 per daughter).

study_card.goal: On top of the validated dnaa-2 succinate baseline, distribute the DnaA-ATP / DnaA-ADP pool across the 315 DnaA boxes (302 chromosomal-high, 3 oriC-high, 8 oriC-low, 2 promoter-high) by affinity — without disturbing the dnaa-2 cell cycle — exposing the bound/free + per-nucleotide partitioning later studies need.
study_card.mechanism: The ADOPTED active DnaA-box binding mechanism (Rashmi's PR #162): a per-tick Langmuir solve that DEPLETES the free DnaA-ATP pool as boxes fill (K_d ≈ 1 nM for the high-affinity pools, ≈ 100 nM for the 8 oriC low-affinity sites, ATP-only). This replaced the earlier read-only occupancy observer, which pinned oriC-low occupancy ~0.8 and never drew down the free pool.
study_card.why_before_next: The bound/free + per-nucleotide partitioning this study provides is the substrate the downstream regulation study (dnaa-4 autoregulation) acts on; the binding must be shown not to break the dnaa-2 cell cycle before that work begins.
study_card.expected_result: Cell cycle preserved (8/8 divisions, oriC 1↔2, 0 re-init), total DnaA in the [300,800] band, and the 8 oriC low-affinity boxes filling GRADUALLY over the cycle (not pre-filled at birth). Boxes double 315↔630 across replication.
study_card.main_expert_question: Is deferring the inherited DnaA-ATP-fraction band [0.2,0.5] to the dnaa-4 regulated-V lever the right call? No single CONSTITUTIVE V satisfies both the DnaA pool band and the ATP-fraction band (the V-tension): tuning V down to hold the pool in [300,800] pushes the fraction to 0.127, below the band.

biological_summary:
DnaA is the master initiator of chromosomal replication in *E. coli*. It binds
short ~9-bp recognition sequences ("DnaA boxes") that occur both at the origin of
replication (oriC) and scattered across the chromosome, plus a pair at its own
promoter. This study models four affinity pools over 315 boxes:

- **Chromosomal high-affinity (302 sites, K_d ≈ 1 nM):** the consensus TTWTNCACA
  boxes computed on the K-12 genome. These bind DnaA-ATP or DnaA-ADP and act as a
  large background reservoir.
- **oriC high-affinity (3 sites: R1, R2, R4, K_d ≈ 1 nM):** the strong oriC anchors,
  essentially always occupied.
- **oriC low-affinity (8 sites, K_d ≈ 100 nM, ATP-only):** the non-consensus sites
  (R5M, τ2, I1, I2, C3, C2, I3, C1) that fill only as free DnaA-ATP accumulates;
  their occupancy is the proximal readout of initiation readiness.
- **dnaA-promoter high-affinity (2 sites, K_d ≈ 1 nM).**

The biology of interest is the LOW-affinity oriC sites. They should fill gradually
over the cell cycle as DnaA-ATP accumulates, reaching high occupancy only near
initiation. A naive read-only equilibrium observer instead pinned them at ~0.8 the
whole cycle ("over-binding") because free DnaA-ATP stayed several-fold above the
100 nM K_d and was never consumed by binding. The ADOPTED active mechanism fixes
this by solving the binding as an actual Langmuir equilibrium that DEPLETES the free
pool: occupied boxes remove DnaA-ATP from solution, so early-cycle occupancy is low
and rises toward initiation — the expected biology. The same fix makes all box
pools double at replication (315↔630, including the low-affinity 8→16 per oriC via
fork passage), which the read-only deriver had hard-coded and under-doubled.

One tension remains and is reported honestly: the fraction of DnaA carrying ATP
(the active form) sits below the literature [0.2,0.5] band on the adopted run,
because active binding sequesters DnaA-ATP onto boxes AND the dnaA synthesis rate
was tuned down to keep the total DnaA pool in [300,800]. No single constitutive
synthesis rate satisfies both bands at once, so closing the ATP fraction is deferred
to a feedback-regulated synthesis lever (the dnaa-4 autoregulation study).

model_change:
ADOPTED: Rashmi's ACTIVE DnaA-box binding mechanism (v2ecoli PR #162, merged),
ported into this study via a flat_overrides/dna_sites.tsv true-override. It
replaces the read-only occupancy observer used earlier in this study.

- Binding is solved as an active Langmuir equilibrium that DEPLETES the free
  DnaA-ATP pool (vs the read-only observer, which only wrote
  listeners.dnaA_binding and never mutated the pool).
- Per-pool free / bound-ATP / bound-ADP counts emitted on
  listeners.replication_data (chromosomal_high, oriC_high, oriC_low, promoter_high).
- All box pools double across replication (315↔630; low-affinity 8→16 per oriC via
  fork-passage release), fixing the read-only deriver's hard-coded low-aff pool.
- The dnaA expression knob V was tuned to 0.8e-3 (from 1e-3) to hold the total DnaA
  pool within [300,800] on the canonical run.
Follow-ups recorded (not done here): remove the now-redundant read-only listener and
re-point the historical charts; and the deeper item Rashmi flagged — DnaA
self-autoregulation is dropped at runtime (delta_prob TU00259[c] self-edge = 0),
which is the dnaa-4 question.

design_pivot_required.question: The read-only occupancy observer pinned oriC-low occupancy ~0.8 (free DnaA-ATP stayed several-fold above the 100 nM K_d for the whole cycle, never drawn down) and its 8 low-affinity sites were a hard-coded pool that did not double at replication. Replace it with Rashmi's ACTIVE depleted-pool Langmuir mechanism?
alternatives: Keep the read-only observer (over-binding unresolved; low-aff pool under-doubled).
Adopt the active mechanism (PR #162) — the Langmuir solve depletes the free pool, so oriC-low fills gradually, and all boxes double 315<->630 at replication.
design_pivot_required.requested_response: Confirm the adopted mechanism is correct and should stand.
design_pivot_required.notes: ADOPTED + verified on our side: over-binding RESOLVED (oriC-low gradual ~0.3→0.7 vs read-only ~0.8), box-doubling FIXED (315↔630), cell cycle clean (8/8 divisions, oriC 1↔2). The read-only-era charts are historical/superseded.

design_pivot_required.question: No constitutive V satisfies both the DnaA pool band [300,800] and the inherited DnaA-ATP-fraction band [0.2,0.5] (the V-tension): tuning V down to hold the pool drives the ATP fraction to 0.127, below the band, and active binding sequesters DnaA-ATP onto boxes. Defer closing the fraction to a regulated-V lever (dnaa-4 negative autoregulation) rather than force a constitutive V?
alternatives: Force a constitutive V to hit the ATP-fraction band (breaks the [300,800] pool band).
Defer to dnaa-4 negative autoregulation (feedback-controlled dnaA synthesis).
design_pivot_required.requested_response: Confirm deferral of the ATP fraction to dnaa-4 is the right scoping.
design_pivot_required.notes: This is why the study verdict is 'partial' rather than a clean pass — the adopted mechanism meets its core goals; the ATP fraction is a known constitutive-V tension, not a refutation of the mechanism.

pools.name: chromosomal_high
pools.source:
307 consensus DnaA boxes (TTWTNCACA, Schaper-Messer) computed at
ParCa-build time on the K-12 genome, MINUS the 3 oriC high-aff + 2
dnaA-promoter high-aff sites broken out into their own pools = 302.

key_assumptions: All 307 consensus DnaA boxes (TTWTNCACA) are high-affinity (K_d ≈ 1 nM).
oriC has 3 high-affinity + 8 low-affinity boxes; low-affinity K_d ≈ 100 nM.
DnaA-ATP and DnaA-ADP binding to boxes is FAST EQUILIBRIUM (only K_d matters; absolute k_fwd/k_rev magnitudes degenerate after the steady-state solve).
DNA binding does NOT alter the DnaA-ATP intrinsic hydrolysis rate (bf8b82e k ≈ 0.046/min applies uniformly to bound and free DnaA-ATP).
Higher-order interactions between low-affinity sites are DEFERRED to a later study.

High-affinity pools track bound-ATP and bound-ADP separately so the correct nucleotide form can be released later by downstream regulatory studies (extrinsic DnaA-ATP/ADP conversion + sequestration; per Haochen's spec).

DISCREPANCY (recorded): the Stage-1 parameter brief lists oriC low-affinity K_d as a 50→1 nM range; dnaa-3 uses Haochen's first-step K_d ≈ 100 nM, with higher-order site interactions deferred to a later study. The spec assumption governs.

inputs_in_place: 307 high-affinity DnaA box catalog computed at ParCa-build (Schaper-Messer consensus on the K-12 genome). Includes the 3 oriC high-aff (R1 −55, R2 +50, R4 +124) and the 2 high-aff dnaA-promoter sites (box1 −41917, box2 −42883).

Static dnaA autorepression via fold_changes_nca.tsv (dnaA→dnaA = −2.31 log2 FC). The 5 weaker dnaA-promoter boxes are intentionally NOT modeled (autorepression already covers self-regulation — do not double-count).
bf8b82e DnaA-ATP intrinsic hydrolysis (k ≈ 0.046/min) active in the equilibrium.

inputs_to_supply.title: 8 low-affinity oriC box coordinates (R5M, τ2, I1, I2, C3, C2, I3, C1)

Extract precise positions from oric_sequence.pdf using R1 (−55), R2 (+50),
R4 (+124) as signed-coordinate anchors. Order along oriC (from the sequence
map): R1 · R5M · τ2 · I1 · I2 · R2 · C3 · C2 · I3 · C1 · R4 — so 4 low-aff
boxes (R5M, τ2, I1, I2) lie between R1 and R2, and 4 (C3, C2, I3, C1)
between R2 and R4.
inputs_to_supply.note:
Treat the coordinates above as approximate ordering aids, NOT final. The REQ
below (extract-low-aff-coords) closes this by pulling exact positions from the
raw oriC sequence.

mechanism + the dnaa-2 nucleotide balance (no cap, no sink), free DnaA-ATP

build_plan.detail:
Split the single "DnaA_box" catalog into chromosomal_high (302), oriC_high
(3: R1/R2/R4), oriC_low (8), promoter_high (2: box1/box2). High-aff = the
302 chromosomal consensus matches minus the 5 broken-out sites; oriC_high +
promoter_high are the 5 named consensus sites; oriC_low is the 8 supplied
coordinates (extract-low-aff-coords). Carry a per-box affinity tier + pool tag.

8 low-aff oriC boxes are NON-consensus → not in the consensus catalog; supply
explicitly. Align literature box sequences to the oriC window of
flat/sequence.fasta (which MATCHES oric_sequence.pdf), using R1/R2/R4 consensus
hits to fix the frame. Order: R5M·τ2·I1·I2 (between R1 & R2) · C3·C2·I3·C1
(between R2 & R4). Replaces inputs_to_supply.provisional_coords_signed.

Add fast-equilibrium binding reactions (integrate_dt=false) to
equilibrium_reactions.tsv + _rates.tsv: per pool, DnaA-ATP(+ADP for high-aff)
+ free-site ⇌ bound-site, K_d = 1 nM (high) / 100 nM (low). Convert K_d →
forward/reverse rates (degenerate magnitudes; pick on-rate ~1e8 /M/s scale).
Hydrolysis k=0.046/min applies to bound DnaA-ATP too (uniform).

High-aff pools need free/bound-ATP/bound-ADP counts; low-aff free/bound-ATP.
Either as bulk species pools or as DnaA_bound→(bound-ATP|bound-ADP) state on
the unique boxes. Box count must double across replication (315→630→315) — the
existing chromosome_structure.py fork logic already duplicates boxes.

Emit per-pool free/bound-ATP/bound-ADP on replication_data; build the 4
visualizations (ATP partition, ADP partition, total boxes raw count, total
bound conc) with the sum-invariant checks.

Run V=1e-3 succinate 8-gen seed=1 burned-in (Rashmi's directed dnaa-2 reproduction, ~35 min). Check
the 4 tests: 8/8 divisions, oriC 1↔2, 0 re-init, DnaA-ATP fraction gen-3 in
[0.2,0.5]. The binding observer is read-only, so it cannot perturb the cycle.

conclusion_logic.if_primary_tests_pass:
The read-only DnaA-box binding observer (315 sites, 4 pools, fast equilibrium)
leaves the dnaa-2 cell cycle intact (8/8 divisions, oriC 1↔2, 0 re-init) and
the DnaA-ATP fraction in [0.2,0.5], while exposing bound/free + per-nucleotide
partitioning. dnaa-3 passes → unblocks the downstream regulatory +
mechanistic-initiation studies that act on bound DnaA.

if_primary_tests_fail.summary:
(Read-only era) The binding observer is READ-ONLY, so it cannot perturb the
cycle; if the cycle differed from the dnaa-2 baseline that points to a wiring
problem, not the binding model; if the box affinities / pool sizes
mis-partition the observed free/bound DnaA, revisit the per-pool K_d / site
counts before layering further regulation.
(Adopted-mechanism era) The one primary test that does NOT pass on the
adopted active-binding run is dnaa-atp-fraction-in-band-gen3: evaluator-computed
0.127 (bulk) / 0.187 (total incl. box-bound), both below the inherited
[0.2,0.5] band. ESTABLISHED here that this is the V-tension — tuning V down to
hold the DnaA pool in [300,800] plus active binding sequestering DnaA-ATP onto
boxes both depress the ATP fraction, and NO single constitutive V closes both
the pool band and the ATP-fraction band — so the fraction cannot be calibrated
within this study. It is deferred to a REGULATED / feedback-controlled DnaA
synthesis lever, not forced.

diagnose.issue: Residual calibration item driving the failed/partial roll-up: on the ADOPTED active-binding run (dnaa3_adopt_v0p8e3_seed0) the DnaA-ATP fraction is 0.127 (bulk) / 0.187 (total incl. box-bound), BELOW the inherited [0.2,0.5] band. ESTABLISHED here that active box binding sequesters DnaA-ATP and that no single CONSTITUTIVE V closes BOTH the in-band DnaA pool [300,800] and the ATP-fraction band — so the fraction is not calibratable within this study; it needs a REGULATED / feedback-controlled DnaA synthesis lever.
diagnose.note: dnaa-4-autoregulation (DnaA negative autoregulation — self-stabilizing the DnaA pool WITHOUT the manual V override) is seeded_from this study and is the diagnostic that dissolves this band-vs-fraction V-tension at its root by wiring DnaA-ATP repression of its own promoter into transcription. The adopted box-binding mechanism is accepted (over-binding resolved, box-doubling fixed, cell cycle clean, pool in band); closing the ATP fraction is deferred to the regulated lever, not outstanding within dnaa-3.

findings.statement:
Across the full cell cycle the oriC high-affinity boxes (K_d ~1 nM) stay
saturated (~1.0) and the 8 oriC low-affinity boxes (K_d ~100 nM) are also high
and roughly flat (0.77-0.83), because free DnaA-ATP (342-491 nM) sits well above
the 100 nM low-affinity K_d for the entire cycle. The low-affinity pool is NOT a
sharp early->late switch under the provided mechanism in this run — it tracks
free DnaA-ATP, which never falls below the K_d. The exact free DnaA-ATP and
oriC low/high occupancy values are read off the read-only artifact (see
runs[dnaa3-readonly-artifact].real_insim_numbers); they are not assumed. Only the
provided binding mechanism is modeled.
oriC and its associated boxes double at replication initiation (11->22 low-affinity boxes), reflected in the occupancy figure.

(Rashmi 2026-06-10, test #1) With the active box-binding mechanism adopted on
the in-band V (V=1e-3, the value used before — NOT the overshooting 1.2e-3),
the total DnaA pool stays WITHIN the literature [300,800] band across the
steady-state generations. Evaluated on the V=1e-3 active-binding lineage.

(Rashmi 2026-06-10, test #2) The 8 oriC low-affinity boxes are NOT all occupied
at the start of the cell cycle — they fill GRADUALLY over the cycle as free
DnaA-ATP accumulates toward initiation (the active solve depletes the free pool,
so early-cycle occupancy is low and rises pre-initiation). Evaluated as the
per-cycle oriC-low occupancy trajectory on the V=1e-3 active-binding run.

evidence.from_run: dnaa3_adopt_v1e3_seed0 (per-tick oriC-low occupancy over a steady gen)

findings.statement: Box-doubling 315<->630 confirmed on the adopted run.
Box-capacity cap removed; over-binding resolved by the active depleted-pool mechanism (no outside mechanism).
Over-binding resolved — gradual oriC-low fill ~0.3->0.7, not pinned ~0.8.
Adopted depleted-pool Langmuir -> oriC-low not prefilled at birth.
Free DnaA reported in nM via cell volume, comparable to the nM K_d.

resolved_uncertainties: The oriC low-affinity OVER-BINDING (read-only observer pinned ~0.8) is RESOLVED by Rashmi's adopted active depleted-pool Langmuir mechanism (PR

ALL DnaA boxes double at replication (315<->630, low-affinity 8->16 per oriC included), via fork-passage release — fixing the read-only deriver's hard-coded low-aff pool (chart dnaa3_active_binding_adopted panel 2).
On the in-band V=1e-3 (the value used before, not the overshooting 1.2e-3) the mechanism keeps a clean cell cycle (8/8 divisions, oriC 1<->2).

remaining_uncertainties.The total DnaA pool DRIFTS above the [30: in-band gens 1-5, 931-1077 in gens 6-8) — the documented dnaa-1/dnaa-2 V-tension. No constitutive V holds it in-band across all gens; the next study (dnaa-4, DnaA negative autoregulation) is scoped to resolve it by making dnaA synthesis feedback-controlled.

remaining_uncertainties: The oriC initiation threshold — what DnaA-ATP occupancy robustly triggers initiation — remains for a later study.

expert_decisions_needed.question: The read-only occupancy observer pinned oriC-low occupancy ~0.8 (free DnaA-ATP stayed several-fold above the 100 nM K_d for the whole cycle, never drawn down) and its 8 low-affinity sites were a hard-coded pool that did not double at replication. Replace it with Rashmi's ACTIVE depleted-pool Langmuir mechanism?
alternatives: Keep the read-only observer (over-binding unresolved; low-aff pool under-doubled).
Adopt the active mechanism (PR #162) — the Langmuir solve depletes the free pool, so oriC-low fills gradually, and all boxes double 315<->630 at replication.
expert_decisions_needed.requested_response: Confirm the adopted mechanism is correct and should stand.
expert_decisions_needed.notes: ADOPTED + verified on our side: over-binding RESOLVED (oriC-low gradual ~0.3→0.7 vs read-only ~0.8), box-doubling FIXED (315↔630), cell cycle clean (8/8 divisions, oriC 1↔2). The read-only-era charts are historical/superseded.

expert_decisions_needed.question: No constitutive V satisfies both the DnaA pool band [300,800] and the inherited DnaA-ATP-fraction band [0.2,0.5] (the V-tension): tuning V down to hold the pool drives the ATP fraction to 0.127, below the band, and active binding sequesters DnaA-ATP onto boxes. Defer closing the fraction to a regulated-V lever (dnaa-4 negative autoregulation) rather than force a constitutive V?
alternatives: Force a constitutive V to hit the ATP-fraction band (breaks the [300,800] pool band).
Defer to dnaa-4 negative autoregulation (feedback-controlled dnaA synthesis).
expert_decisions_needed.requested_response: Confirm deferral of the ATP fraction to dnaa-4 is the right scoping.
expert_decisions_needed.notes: This is why the study verdict is 'partial' rather than a clean pass — the adopted mechanism meets its core goals; the ATP fraction is a known constitutive-V tension, not a refutation of the mechanism.

variants.description:

oriC-high 3 @1nM, oriC-low 8 @100nM ATP-only, promoter-high 2 @1nM) on the
dnaa-2 V=1e-3 succinate burned-in baseline. The single reference config for
